description: This file defines the `ExecAllowlistMatcher` enum, which provides static methods for matching executable paths against allowlist patterns. It includes functions to match individual entries, process multiple resolutions, and compile regex patterns for pattern matching.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a resolution against a list of entries, returning the first matching entry if any.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Matches multiple resolutions against a list of entries, returning all matching entries.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a target string matches a pattern using regex after normalization.

methods.name: normalizeMatchTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a path string by replacing backslashes with slashes and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: regex
methods.description: Generates a NSRegularExpression object from a pattern with wildcards '*' and '?'.
